name: NGC 3818 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3818, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3818-hubble
story: NGC 3818 is a low-luminosity elliptical galaxy living far from crowded galaxy clusters. Hubble surveyed the globular star clusters that swarm around it, ancient fossils that record when and how its stars were made.

claims.text: NGC 3818 was a target of Hubble program 10554 on globular cluster systems of low-luminosity elliptical galaxies in low-density environments
Globular cluster populations probe a galaxy's star formation and metal enrichment history
